environment.description: Kubernetes pod running the stream processor with default seccomp profile (runtime/default). Kafka topic 'events.raw' accepts messages up to 10MB (server-side max.message.bytes=10485760). The metrics dashboard is served on port 8080 via an internal ALB with no content security restrictions. CDN URL is configurable via METRICS_SCRIPT_CDN_URL environment variable injected through a ConfigMap that operations team manages. No message size validation at the producer level.
